# DocuExtract

> Browser-based invoice PDF extraction. Exports a combined XLSX workbook, invoice-level CSV, line-item CSV and JSON with validation status.

## Canonical website
https://manayab.github.io/DocuExtract.tech/

## Version and status
The source repository's canonical SITE configuration declares version 1.3.1. The deployed app version and formal GitHub release status were NOT VERIFIED during the 2026-10-29 landing-page update.

## Product facts
DocuExtract processes PDF files in the browser; application code does not upload invoice files to an application backend. The application has no account, backend, database, analytics or telemetry. Review extracted information before accounting, tax, payment or legal use.

- Batch queue: up to 50 PDFs; per-file progress, statuses and possible-duplicate detection.
- Per-file limits documented by the app: 25 MB and 100 pages.
- Multiple invoices in a PDF: split attempt when invoice number changes; multi-page invoices are kept together. Boundary edge cases are not fully tested.
- GST-aware fields: GSTIN, HSN, taxable value, tax rate, tax amount, CGST, SGST and IGST.
- Locales: en-IN, en-US, en-GB and de-DE. Ambiguous numeric dates are flagged; reprocessing protects manual edits.
- XLSX: combined workbook with invoice rows and supporting sheets.
- CSV: invoice-level rows or line-item rows.
- JSON: includes validation status.
- Extraction is heuristic; no accuracy guarantee is made.

## OCR
OCR is optional and build-dependent. When the build bundles its assets, Tesseract runs locally using English language data only, up to 20 pages per PDF. OCR confidence is capped at 75%, and OCR results are marked Review. Poor scans, handwriting and skewed pages may produce weak results.
The currently deployed app's OCR assets and live network requests were NOT VERIFIED. Do not assume OCR is enabled in every build.

## Privacy and security
Files are processed locally by this application and are not uploaded by application code. Verify your own browser network activity in the Network tab if your environment requires independent confirmation. Invoice data is not written to URLs, localStorage or sessionStorage; PDF buffers are released and documents destroyed after processing. Export handling sanitizes formula-injection risks. The app documents a restrictive CSP and same-origin OCR assets when bundled; live headers and requests were NOT VERIFIED.

## Limitations
Encrypted PDFs are rejected unless already decrypted; corrupt PDFs are not supported. Handwriting, poor scans and skewed pages are not reliably recognized. Invoice splitting relies on invoice-number changes. Always review fields, line items, dates and tax values against the original document.
